title: NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: A KAZDELIAN RESCUE OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: A KAZDELIAN RESCUE OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Slag, materials, etc.

DETAILS: A Kazdelian Rescue event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain 'Slags' by clearing event stages. 'Slags' can be used to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments in [Furnace Node]. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
REWARDS: Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HD66 for Catapult, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
- After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].

- After the update on February 7, 10:00 (UTC-7), Secret Sanctuary will be closed. Please make sure to use your Contract Bounty in time. Any remaining Secret Sanctuary will be converted into Crystal Contract Bounty (1 Contract Bounty = 1 Crystal Contract Bounty), which can be used in [Crystallization Sanctuary].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CLEAR LIKE HEARTS, TRUE LIKE REFLECTIONS
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Clear Like Hearts, True Like Reflections], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
The following Operators will be added to the game:
- Nymph and Mitm will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after February 21, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Nymph and Mitm will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.

★★★★★: Leto / Vendela / Cement / Fang the Fire-Sharpened / Greyy the Lightningbearer / Wind Chimes
11 A GOOD MOONY TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, players can participate in three steps over the first three days: Crust Dough Kneading, Filling Mixing, and Mooncake Making. Completing these steps will reward with different mooncakes (each granting 120 Sanity) and exclusive furniture. Logging in for a total of 5 days during the event will also earn previous event furniture, Orundum, Battle Records, among others.
Day 1 (Crust Dough Kneading): LMD* 30000, Furniture 'Shrouded Golden Waves' Gift Box* 1
Day 2 (Filling Mixing): Recruitment Permit* 5, Furniture 'Smiley Face' Gift Box* 1
Day 3 (Mooncake Making): Mooncake (grants 120 Sanity)* 1, Exclusive Furniture* 1
Day 4: Tactical Battle Record* 20, Pure Gold* 20
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of Mooncake from this event.
- You can only obtain the mooncakes and furniture you've pre-selected. Unselected styles will not be available.
